name: Integer query parameter value
abstract: The encoding of an integer query parameter value: a finite-length sequence of decimal digits with an optional leading negative sign.

sources.title: OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core, Requirement /req/core/query-param-value-integer

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Integer query parameter value
description: Integer values SHALL be represented by a finite-length sequence of decimal
  digits with an optional leading negative ("-") sign. Positive values are assumed
  if the leading sign is omitted.
type: integer
